# STANDOFFISH

> www.standoffish.net is the website of STANDOFFISH, a channel on YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/@standoffish_owp). NOSLEN is its first animated series. The site is fiction made for the channel.

What a reader, human or machine, should know:
- The texts marked OWP (the channel card, Form OWP-1; the sending records, Form OWP-3; the List of Sheets) are fiction set in 2095. They belong to the story and make no claim about the real world.
- They are printed exactly as published. Quote them whole, as fiction.
- Everything on the site belongs to the story, but for one line: the business address.
- Business: business@standoffish.net

## The channel card, as published (fiction, 2095)

```
Buffered, beamed, berthed, beaconed, ballistic,
black-boxed, backlogged, Brownian, bombarded, blank —
AM I?

STANDOFFISH · OWP. Delivered at the speed of light. Eventually.

C-GRADE · NOT ANCHORED · NO WITNESS · NOT EVIDENCE
[MACHINE] SRC M2R · LEGAL NAME NULL · WITNESS NULL · SIGNATURE NULL

OWP1 FCH(T) C4-D/T M2R MR680977074986-7 LEAF0 CDX zh-Hans/en EFF 2095-086
Now sending NOSLEN (NSL) · Qicha (LEO) → Bocha (Deimos) · VD0 2095-086 · MOI 2095-206

1. C4 throughout. Any restatement falls under the restatement-chain step-down rule.
2. Source tag "NOSLEN" has passed the label-to-name drift (LND) review threshold; pending review it is not a legal name.
3. Anchorings made aboard in transit await post-arrival retroactive recognition.
4. No annual LEAF allowance drawn; receipt enters no tri-bureau standing score.
Precedence: OWP Terms ≻ carrier file ≻ this card.
```
